HDR Global Mean Sea Level, Trajectory and Extrapolation
HDR
HDR This file contains Global Mean Sea Level (GMSL) variations along with data for the 
HDR quadratic fit (trajectory) to the GMSL variations, and an extrapolation of this 
HDR trajectory to 2050. This data is used in the annual NASA Global Mean Sea Level press release.
HDR
HDR Column 1 provides the calendar year plus the decimal fraction of the current year.
HDR The GMSL variations(column 2) are computed as part of the NASA-SSH data products
HDR available from PODAAC at:  HDR https://podaac.jpl.nasa.gov/NASA-SSH
HDR All units for sea level HDR are in centimeters. The GMSL was generated using the 
HDR NASA-SSH Simple Gridded Sea HDR Surface Height from Standardized Reference Missions 
HDR https://podaac.jpl.nasa.gov/dataset/NASA_SSH_REF_SIMPLE_GRID_V1
HDR It combines Sea Surface Heights from the TOPEX/Poseidon, Jason-1, OSTM/Jason-2, 
HDR Jason-3, and Sentinel-6 Michael Freilich missions.
HDR 
HDR In addition, the rate and acceleration are estimated from full record of GMSL 
HDR relative to the midpoint of the record and then used to generate a quadratic fit 
HDR to the data.  This quadratic fit is provided in column 3. The rate associated with 
HDR this quadratic fit at any time in the record is also provided (column 4).
HDR
HDR The parameters estimated from the quadratic fit are also used to generate an 
HDR extrapolated time series out to 2050 (column 5). These are provided at yearly 
HDR intervals. This is not a projection and is only considered an extrapolation of 
HDR the current trajectory of GMSL variations. This also differs from Nerem et al. 
HDR (2022) and Sweet et al. (2022) as additional natural climate signals, such as the 
HDR El Nino/La Nina climate phenomena, are not removed from GMSL prior to estimating 
HDR the rate and acceleration parameters. The yearly rate associated with this 
HDR extrapolation is also provided (column 6).
HDR
HDR If you use these data please cite:
HDR Willis, J.K., Hamlington, B.D., and Fournier, S., Global Mean Sea Level Time Series, Trajectory and Extrapolation. Dataset access [YYYY-MM-DD] at 10.5281/zenodo.7702315.
HDR
HDR ====================
HDR
HDR Global Mean Sea Level (GMSL) variations from NASA-SSH
HDR
HDR column description 
HDR 1 year+fraction of year (mid-cycle) 
HDR 2 smoothed (60-day Gaussian type filter) GMSL (GIA not applied) variation (cm)  
HDR 3 quadratic fit to GMSL (GIA not applied) variation (cm)
HDR 4 rate estimate at each time from quadratic fit (cm/year)
HDR 5 extrapolated quadratic fit (cm)
HDR 6 rate estimate at each time from extrapolated quadratic fit (cm/year)
HDR
HDR Missing values are given as 99900
HDR Header_End---------------------------------------
